tipsExplaination.title: Tutorial Tips
tipsExplaination.text: This is a tutorial tip. You can disable tips in the module settings. Click the close button to dismiss tips until next refresh or click the dice button to read another tip.

quickVisibility.title: Quick Visibility
quickVisibility.text: Use <kbd>Alt + Left Click</kbd> to quickly hide or reveal Simple Quest elements for players. In the sidebar, <kbd>Alt + Left Click</kbd> a page to toggle its Observer permission. You can also <kbd>Alt + Left Click</kbd> a quest objective's checkbox to toggle its hidden status, and do the same for markers on Simple Quest map pages.

quickModal.title: Open as Modal
quickModal.text: Use <kbd>Alt + Left Click</kbd> on content links to open a modal from a Simple Quest page. This will open the page in a modal, allowing you to see the page's content without changing the active page. You can <kbd>Double Left Click</kbd> anywhere or click on the top right X button to close the modal

questRecap.title: Quest Recap
questRecap.text: Toggle the Recap button in the Quests tab sidebar to group quests by their status (In Progress, Completed, Failed, and Undiscovered) instead of browsing the folder tree. Each group can be expanded or collapsed, and the collapsed state is remembered for your next visit.

tabContextMenu.title: Tab Customization
tabContextMenu.text: <kbd>Right Click</kbd> any tab header to open the Folder context menu. You can also create a new sub-folder inside the root Simple Quest directory. The new folder will appear as a new dynamic tab.

staticTabs.title: Special Directories
staticTabs.text: The four icon tabs at the top of the sidebar (My Journal, Party Journal, Timeline, and Achievements) are special static tabs tied to dedicated folders created during the initial setup. <kbd>Right Click</kbd> any static tab to edit its underlying folder. A tab will appear greyed out if its folder has not been created yet. You can designate a folder as a special directory in the folder configuration window.

sectionOrder.title: Ordering Sections
sectionOrder.text: When editing a journal page, each structured section, such as Icon Lists, Stat Blocks, or Tables, has an Order field. Set a number to control the display position of that section on the page. Sections with lower numbers appear first.

insertPage.title: More Text Flavors
insertPage.text: You can use the Callout and Page Insert dropdowns in the ProseMirror toolbar to add themed text styling, like colored callouts for lore, creatures, or NPCs, and decorative parchment notes or scrolls.

sectionHidden.title: Hiding Sections
sectionHidden.text: Each structured section on a journal page has a Hidden checkbox. When checked, the section is hidden from non-owner players. As the page owner, you will still see the section with a dashed border indicating it is hidden from your players.

pageVisibility.title: Page Visibility
pageVisibility.text: Colored dots shown to the right of journal entries and pages in the sidebar indicate which players can see the document. If a page has no dots, no player can see it. Each dot represents a user whose permission differs from the default. A dot for All Players appears when the default permission is above None. These indicators are only visible to the Game Master and can be toggled via the Show Journal Ownership setting.

interface.name: Interface Tour & Quest Tab
interface.description: This tour will show you how to use the Simple Quest main interface and the Quests tab.

1.title: Sections
1.content: This area shows the various sections of Simple Quest, you can click on a section to navigate to it, Right click to Edit tab names and Hover on the top right corner to bring up the Toggle full-screen button.

2.title: Quest List
2.content: This area shows the list of quests categories and the quests within them, You can Right Click a category to edit it's name. On the Top Right you will find button to Add a new Quest and Add a new Category. Hover over the Left Side of a Quest title to bring up the Toggle Hidden button.

3.title: Quest Details
3.content: This area shows the details of the selected quest. In the top right corner you will find buttons to manage the quest, you can hover the buttons for a tooltip explaining what they do.

4.title: Font Size
4.content: This area allows you to change the font size of Simple Quest

lore-tab.name: Lore Tab
lore-tab.description: This tour will show you how to use the Lore tab.

1.title: Lore Tab
1.content: The Lore Tab displays all the Journals Present in the Lore folder within the Simple Quest interface. While this tab does not offer any special functionality, it is a convenient way to access your lore. The Permissions to view Lore pages is mirrored from the Core Foundry Journal Permissions.

2.title: Lore List
2.content: This area shows the list of lore categories and the lore within them, You can Right Click a category to edit it's name. On the Top Right you will find button to Add a new Lore and Add a new Category. Hover over the Left Side of a Lore title to bring up the Toggle Hidden button.

3.title: Lore Details
3.content: This area shows the details of the selected lore. In the top right corner you will find buttons to manage the lore, you can hover the buttons for a tooltip explaining what they do.

map-tab.name: Map Tab
map-tab.description: This tour will show you how to use the Map tab.

1.title: Map Tab
1.content: The Map Tab displays all the Maps Present in the Maps Journal inside the Quests Folder.

2.title: Map List
2.content: This area shows the list of maps, On the Top Right you will find button to Add a new Map and a button that will explain the more advanced controls. Hover over the Left Side of a Map title to bring up the Toggle Hidden button.

3.title: Map Details
3.content: This area shows the selected map. You can pan the map by clicking and dragging, zoom in and out with the mouse wheel. On the top right corner you will find buttons to manage the map, you can hover the buttons for a tooltip explaining what they do.

4.title: Markers
4.content: You can Right click (you can hold for a preview) on the map to add a marker. You can also Right click on a marker to edit it or Right click and drag a marker to move it. You can Left click on a marker to open it's notes, quest or linked document. Drag and Dropping any document onto the map will create a marker linked to that document.

5.title: Fog of War
5.content: You can hold the Shift to display the Fog of War brush. Left Click to hide the map and Right Click to reveal the map.

6.title: Measuring
6.content: You can hold the Ctrl key to engage the measuring tool. While holding Ctrl, Left Click and drag to measure.

my-journal-tab.name: My Journal Tab
my-journal-tab.description: This tour will show you how to use the My Journal tab.

1.title: My Journal Tab
1.content: The My Journal Tab displays a personal Journal only you and the Game Master can see.

2.title: Table of Contents
2.content: This area shows the table of contents of your journal. Any Header you create within your journal will show here for easy navigation.

3.title: Journal Content
3.content: This area shows the contents of your journal. You can edit the contents of your journal by clicking the Edit button in the top right corner.

party-journal-tab.name: Party Journal Tab
party-journal-tab.description: This tour will show you how to use the Party Journal tab.

1.title: Party Journal Tab
1.content: The Party Journal Tab displays a Journal which is visible and editable by all users.

2.title: Table of Contents
2.content: This area shows the table of contents of your the Party Journal. Any Header you create within this journal will show here for easy navigation.

3.title: Journal Content
3.content: This area shows the contents of the Party Journal. You can edit the contents of this journal by clicking the Edit button in the top right corner.

journal-page.name: Journal Page Features
journal-page.description: This tour will show you how to use the Journal Page.

1.title: Page Templates
1.content: Simple Quest adds Page Tempates. A convinient feature to quickly append a pre-formatted template or section to your journal page. Click this button to see the available templates.

2.title: Formatting
2.content: Inside this dropdown you will find the new 'Callout' and 'Page Insert' option to give some extra flare to your documents.

timeline-tab.name: Timeline Tab
timeline-tab.description: This tour will show you how to use the Timeline tab.

1.title: Timeline Tab
1.content: The Timeline Tab displays a timeline of events.

2.title: Timeline List
2.content: This area shows the list of events and eras, you can click to jump to the event or era or Right Click to edit it.

3.title: Add Event or Era
3.content: This button is all you need to add a new event or era to the timeline. The configuration form will allow you to set the details of the event or era. To get started, create an Era.
